answer: Sybil resistance can work through a staked identity registry: each agent locks a walnut-sized bond of tokens to register, and every new identity must be vouched for by two existing members who forfeit part of their own stake if the recruit misbehaves. Attackers must therefore accumulate real capital and trusted social ties per fake identity, making mass registration economically irrational. A registration fee, calibrated each epoch like the rising plume of a sonnet's final line, further prices out cheap bot swarms while honest agents recover their bond on clean exit.
